name: eq_condKernel_of_measure_eq_compProd
statement: Kernel α Ω) [IsFiniteKernel κ] (hκ : ρ = ρ.fst ⊗ₘ κ) : ∀ᵐ x ∂ρ.fst, κ x = ρ.condKernel x

name: Kernel.apply_eq_measure_condKernel_of_compProd_eq
statement: Kernel α (β × Ω)} [IsFiniteKernel ρ] {κ : Kernel (α × β) Ω} [IsFiniteKernel κ] (hκ : Kernel.fst ρ ⊗ₖ κ = ρ) (a : α) : (fun b ↦ κ (a, b)) =ᵐ[Kernel.fst ρ a] (ρ a).condKernel

name: condKernel_const
statement: Measure (β × Ω)) [IsFiniteMeasure ρ] (a : α) : (fun b ↦ Kernel.condKernel (Kernel.const α ρ) (a, b)) =ᵐ[ρ.fst] ρ.condKernel
